name: The Mechanic
summary: Jack's ad-hoc audit/ops session for Claude Code fleet efficiency (model selection, session hygiene, credit waste), not a built product. Real wins: archived ~30 dead/duplicate sessions, killed a 2.5-day stuck process, built the daily Mac performance watchdog (confirmed still running clean). Open, unresolved problem: scheduled tasks silently default to the expensive Opus-5-1M model regardless of settings, filed as an external Anthropic bug (github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/91884); a workaround applied 9/14 was reverified live 9/21 against 3 fresh scheduled-task runs and did NOT hold, all three still ran on Opus-5-1M. Real, ongoing cost waste, not resolved despite the earlier fix attempt.
